FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

Catalogue questions.

+Why don’t you show prices?

BCP parts vary by make, material, quantity and documentation, so we quote each request. This helps keep pricing accurate and lets our engineers confirm that the part is suitable for your unit.

+How do I know which part I need?

Send the pump and motor nameplate, a photo of the part and its application. Our engineers will help identify it.

+What warranty do you give on parts?

Warranty terms are confirmed for the quoted part and scope. The source document states the same basis as the OEM warranty.
